ability.lensouls.weakness_lens.detail:
Hold a camera enchanted with §bSoul Photography§r (Polaroid recommended) and take a photo
Records the §dclosest living entity§r, producing a §aWeakness Lens§r photo
This photo can be placed into the sword slot of an item enchanted with §bSoul Photography§r
§aHold the photo in one hand and that item in the other, then right-click§r to insert, or to §areplace§r an existing photo (the old one returns to your inventory)
You can also search §aOpen Weakness Lens Sword Slot GUI§r in the keybind settings
§cDurability: 100 uses — each effective use (bonus damage on the subject, or its granted element activity hitting a weakness) costs 1, and it is destroyed when depleted§r
§dIt also identifies the creature's weakness element and records it in the photo§r
Once installed, the weapon counts as having §alevel 2 weapon activity§r of that element (a higher native level wins)
§dDeals bonus damage§r
ability.lensouls.spatial_warp.detail:
Hold a camera enchanted with §bSoul Photography§r (Polaroid recommended) and take a photo
With the §aSpatial Warp§r ability active
records the current position, producing a §aSpatial Warp§r photo
§bHold the photo and left-click§r to toggle the spatial sphere
A §6low-poly orange sphere§r is rendered on screen
Blocks and entities inside the sphere can be §einteracted with, mined and attacked§r §dfrom any distance§r
ability.lensouls.temporal_recall.detail:
Hold a camera enchanted with §bSoul Photography§r (Polaroid recommended) and take a photo
Keep the §aTemporal Recall§r ability active while shooting
Records your position, view direction, health and saturation
Once you have a §aTemporal Recall§r photo
§dKeeping it in your inventory takes effect when you take lethal damage§r
Upon triggering, you return to the capture location
Health and saturation reset to the recorded values
Your items are not modified
§rYou can also §bhold it and left-click§r to trigger it manually
§aMultiple triggers in a short time stack vulnerability
§aEvery five recalls stack one level§r
§aUntil the state resets in the background or you truly die§r
§r§r§cPhoto stacking does not affect triggering§r
ability.lensouls.time_stop.detail:
Hold a camera enchanted with §bSoul Photography§r and take a photo
Attempts to §dfreeze entities in view§r when shooting
After a successful freeze is cast
As long as any entity is frozen
§cYou cannot cast another freeze§r
Shooting during this period shows an entity-style text prompt
(Similar to the rename display you see on mobs)
§cThis ability has a 30% chance of failing against toughness targets§r
100% ineffective during break
A miss particle is emitted on failure
§cShooting consumes film and paper§r
§aIt does not produce a photo with special properties§r
ability.lensouls.vital_strike.detail:
Hold a camera enchanted with §bSoul Photography§r and take a photo
§cDeals one toughness damage without consuming film or paper§r
And §athis white hyper-armor duration is shortened by 50%§r
White hyper-armor is the brief period during which toughness cannot be reduced
ability.lensouls.soul_sever.detail:
Hold a camera enchanted with §bSoul Photography§r and take a photo
§cEnters one judgement without consuming film or paper§r
§aHas a 30% chance to deal§r
§a10% to 20% of the target's current HP as magic damage§r
§cCan never cut below 50% of the target's max HP§r
§cBelow 50% max HP no percentage damage is dealt§r
10s cooldown on success, 0.5s on failure
ability.lensouls.ability_steal.detail:
Hold a camera enchanted with §bSoul Photography§r (Polaroid recommended) and take a photo
Keep the §aAbility Steal§r ability active while shooting
Selects the nearest entity and records its data into the photo
Once you have an §aAbility Steal§r photo
§dIf it matches the entity, the equip effect is displayed
§bIt can be equipped in the Photo slot of the curio inventory§r§r
Search @lensouls in JEI to see supported entities
ability.lensouls.wild_glimpse.detail:
Hold a camera enchanted with §bSoul Photography§r (Polaroid recommended) and take a photo
Keep the §aWild Glimpse§r ability active while shooting
It §drecords the mobs inside the frame§r into the photo
§dRecorded mobs automatically unlock their Field Guide entries§r
§cOnly mobs are recorded — plants and environment are exempt§r
§aTargets behind walls or underground are never captured§r
